name: rechoose
description: Rechoose web app and iOS application

scripts.check: npm run check:i18n && npm run check:i18n-keys
scripts.ios:build: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath .build/ios CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
